news.title: Private keys, not smart contracts, caused 40% of crypto's $16 billion hack losses. Here's whats being done.
news.summary: The industry is moving toward fixing the private key vulnerability issue, just not evenly, Wish Wu, co-founder and CEO of Pharos, said.

news.title: White House to speak with law enforcement groups to push Crypto's Clarity Act
news.summary: Officials from the White House are said to be sitting down with law enforcement representatives who have objected to illicit-finance portions of the bill.

news.title: J.P. Morgan broadens blockchain settlement network as banks modernize cross-border payments
news.summary: The bank added five Asia-Pacific currencies to its Kinexys blockchain platform, allowing institutional clients to settle payments and FX around the clock.

news.title: Crypto analytics firm Chainalysis proposes standards for blockchain tracing
news.summary: The blockchain analysis company published a proposed ontology for how investigators can identify clusters of crypto addresses and link them together.

news.title: MiCA's looming deadline could leave 10 million crypto users without a platform in the EU
news.summary: As MiCA takes full effect on July 1, SwissBorg's Alex Fazel told CoinDesk users should choose platforms built to withstand EU regulators' tightening oversight.

news.title: Ripple wants institutions to borrow against tokenized assets on XRPL
news.summary: A proposed XRPL standard would let institutions borrow against tokenized assets, with the blockchain enforcing loan terms while the underwriting stays with human credit teams. It still needs validator approval to go live.

news.title: Wall Street's BNY expands stablecoin services for institutions, starting with Circle's USDC
news.summary: The world's largest custody bank is adding USDC custody and minting services as stablecoins move deeper into traditional finance.

news.title: Strategy opens door to selling billions of bitcoin under new capital plan. Here's what it means
news.summary: The company can now sell bitcoin to fund the USD reserve, support preferred dividends, and finance up to $2 billion in stock buybacks.

news.title: ‘It feels like a medical miracle’: How did a single QR code coupon cut my $618 Walgreens prescription to $15?
Fed’s Lisa Cook can stay on at central bank while challenging Trump’s attempt to fire her, Supreme Court rules
news.summary: The Supreme Court has refused to allow President Donald Trump to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, in a move that strengthens the independence of the central bank.

news.title: I’m a CPA and tell my clients to claim Social Security early. Am I giving them bad advice?
news.summary: “Only 8% to 10% of people wait until age 70 to claim.”

news.title: Wall Street is bracing for a wave of Fed rate hikes that may never come. These sectors stand to gain.
news.summary: Inflation isn’t as high as you think — and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh looks less hawkish than advertised.

news.title: There’s a ‘Trump account’ hack that can unlock decades of wealth-building for your kid
news.summary: “The only reason” to use these accounts is “if you’re planning to do the Roth strategy,” says one financial planner.

news.title: Strategy can now sell bitcoin to buy back stock — the opposite of what it’s been doing
news.summary: Strategy disclosed a program to sell bitcoin “from time to time” to fund its U.S. dollar reserve and share repurchases.

news.title: Going back to the office may actually be better for you than working from home
news.summary: Returning to the office — even just a few days a week — might be what fully remote workers actually need.
